title: Reinventing BFSI: From Transformation to Intelligent, Trusted Growth
summary: An invitation-only forum bringing together senior leaders from across industries to exchange perspectives on the forces reshaping business, customer relationships, and growth.
body_markdown:
Concentrix Circle


# Growth Reimagined


December 2


2:00pm–7:00pm


75 Varick Street Rooftop
Downtown New York City


### AI is about to change how your customers choose, buy, and pay. Their trust is the one thing it can’t replace, but earning it is about to get harder.


On December 2nd, join us as executives from Truist, Citi, Fiserv, Spotify, and Proof share how they keep customers when every product looks alike, prepare for AI that buys on their behalf, decide where speed ends and trust begins, and build the teams ready for what’s next.


Featuring Katie Linendoll, a Silicon Valley visionary and Emmy Award winner who has spent two decades telling America what’s coming next in tech.


**The afternoon concludes with a networking cocktail hour.**

## What We’ll Explore


- **Customer Growth & Experience:** Winning a customer is getting more expensive. Keeping them is where the growth is. See how personalized experiences turn one-off transactions into relationships that last.
- **Intelligence & Agentic AI:** AI is moving from answering questions to taking action. Discover how intelligent operations are speeding up decisions, lifting productivity, and changing how service gets delivered.
- **Trust, Risk & Resilience:** Every new capability brings new exposure. Learn how leaders are keeping governance, compliance, cybersecurity, and resilience strong as the rules get more complex.
- **Data & Modern Platform Transformation:** Ambitious AI plans stall on weak foundations. Explore the data platforms and operating models that let growth scale, with banking’s modernization as the case in point.
- **Workforce Transformation:** New tools bring new roles, new skills, and new ways of working. See how organizations are preparing their people now, rather than after the technology arrives.
- **Leadership Action:** By 2030, the gap between leaders and the rest will be set by decisions being made today. Leave with a clearer view of the strategies and operating models that will matter.


## Meet our Host


#### Katie Linendoll


Katie Linendoll is an Emmy Award-winning TV personality, national consumer technology expert, emcee, and keynote speaker.


For nearly two decades, Katie has been a trusted technology contributor to the TODAY Show. Her extensive media career also includes eight years at ESPN, along with hosting, on-air, and editorial work for The Weather Channel, SiriusXM, A&E, The Wall Street Journal, Sports Illustrated, and Popular Science, to name a few.


As an emcee and keynote speaker, Katie has led major technology and business events for organizations including Mercedes-Benz, Lenovo, HP, IBM, SAP, Teradata, OpenText, Qlik, Comcast, and the Global Semiconductor Alliance. Known for combining deep technology expertise with high-energy storytelling, she helps audiences understand what is next in AI, innovation, and consumer technology.


Named a Silicon Valley Visionary, Katie leads a Faith-filled, active lifestyle and dedicates significant time to philanthropic causes supporting healthcare, retired K9s, and U.S. Veterans. She is also passionate about music, with original songs and music videos that have charted on radio and iTunes.


## Run of Show


### Agenda


**2:00-2:30**


**Welcome to the Concentrix Circle: Growth Reimagined**


Rising customer expectations. AI-driven disruption. Expanding risk. A workforce in transition. Four forces, one collision, and the operating environment every business runs in has changed. The question is no longer whether to move; it’s whether your customers will still trust you when you do.


In this opening address, we look at where financial services is winning, where it’s exposed, and why the answers travel far beyond banking.


**2:30-3:00**


**Session 1 – The Experience Imperative – How People, Technology, and Connected Experiences Shape the Future of Financial Services**


Billions have gone into the customer experience. The employee experience got what was left. Now that the gap is showing up in productivity, innovation, and performance, leaders are looking for ways to close it, fast.


Hear how Apple is building the workplace of the future, accelerating adoption, and connecting people across every boundary, so the experience inside finally matches the one outside.


*Moderator: Kathryn Harrison – GVP, Strategy & Business Operations at Concentrix*


**3:00-3:30**


**Session 2 – Where Will Financial Services Find Its Next Growth Engine?**


As growth becomes harder to find, organizations are exploring other ways to achieve it: partnerships, ecosystems, intelligent technology, and importantly, the people who connect them.


Join us as leaders from Fiserv, DUB, Bernstein Wealth Management, and Concentrix discuss how financial institutions can expand beyond traditional models while bringing the entire workforce with them.


*Moderator: Tom McCormick – Global Operations & CX Executive | Strategic Advisor | Enterprise Transformation & Global Sourcing Panelists: Guy Bourgault – Head of Agentic Services at Concentrix Mike Leary – VP CX Insights at Huntington Bank Amanda Wiltshire-Craine – SVP, Head of Operations at Financial Solutions (FiServ) Brett Chereskin – COO of DUB*


**3:30-3:45**


Break


**3:45-4:15**


**Session 3 – Know Your Agent: Building Trust in Agentic Commerce**


As AI agents increasingly act on behalf of consumers and businesses, financial institutions and merchants face a new trust challenge: establishing who an agent represents, what it is authorized to do, and whether a particular transaction falls within that authority.


This session explores how customer verification, agent identity and authorization, fraud prevention, and third-party governance must work together to enable agentic commerce. Leaders will discuss what institutions need to consider supporting in a future of legitimate agent activity—and how responsibility should be established when something goes wrong.


*Moderator: Shy Daraeikia – Risk and Compliance Practice Lead, North America Panelists: Jeffrey Bashore – Financial Crimes Executive Tim Carbery – Managing Partner @ Castle Hill (a CNX Company) Adam Lemmon – VP, Partnerships- Identity, Agentic Commerce, Bitcoin at Proof Ed Hartigan – Director, Trust and Safety*


**4:15-4:45**


**Session 4 – Women Leading the Next Era of Business: Building the Financial Services Organization of the Future**


What can leaders across industries learn from the transformation of financial services? As AI, customer expectations, and workforce needs reshape the sector, leadership must evolve with them. Hear how women leaders are navigating transformation, developing the next generation of talent, and building resilient organizations ready for what comes next.


*Moderator: Katie Linendoll Panelists: Kathryn Harrison, GVP – Strategy & Business Operations at Concentrix Sherry Graziano – EVP, Head of Digital, Client Experience and Marketing at Truist Misty Stiers – SVP, Head of Inclusive Design at Citi Amanda Wiltshire-Craine – SVP, Head of Operations at Financial Solutions (Fiserv) Sally Tonel – Global Head of Customer Service at Spotify*


**5:00-7:00**


**Networking Reception**


Connect with fellow leaders over cocktails and hors d’oeuvres, exchange perspectives, and build new relationships. Continue the conversations shaping the future of business, including financial services, and explore the challenges and opportunities shared across industries.

**Gain Strategic Perspective**
Explore how leaders across banking, fintech, and insurance are responding to rapidly changing market conditions.


**Explore Actionable Innovation**
Discover how organizations are applying AI, data, and automation to improve customer outcomes, reduce complexity, and drive measurable business value.


**Learn from Industry Peers**
Exchange practical insights and lessons learned with fellow senior executives facing similar challenges and opportunities.


**Shape the Future of Financial Services** Contribute to conversations about the capabilities and leadership strategies required for success through 2030 and beyond.

## Meet the Speakers

Panelists & Moderators


#### Sally Tonel


Global Head of Customer Service, Spotify


Sally Alejandro Tonel believes every customer conversation is a chance to learn something, and she has built a career on listening closely. She leads Spotify’s Global Customer Service business, shaping how millions of listeners and creators around the world experience support. She sees customer service as more than solving problems. To her, it’s one of the company’s richest sources of customer insight and a powerful driver of loyalty and growth.


Sally has spent two decades at some of the world’s most recognizable brands. She began her career in marketing and communications at AIG and American Express, then took a front-row seat to leadership as a chief of staff before stepping into running large service operations. That’s where she found her stride. She fell in love with the puzzle of complex operations and the sense of community that support teams create. At American Express, she led a large Concierge organization serving Platinum and Centurion Card Members. Since joining Spotify in 2020, Sally has built the CX discipline from scratch and turned the voice of the customer into better products, stronger retention and smarter operations. Now, she leads the team through AI innovation.


People know Sally as a transformative leader who brings clarity to change. She turns complex transformations into clear, compelling stories, so every team member understands the “why” and sees exactly where they fit in. Relationships are at the heart of how she leads. She takes pride in building trust across functions, levels and geographies, and she uses those partnerships to align stakeholders, break down silos, deliver win-win results and create environments where teams can learn and thrive.


Sally holds a Marketing degree from Rutgers University. She lives in New Jersey with her husband, where they’re raising two ambitious kids who love to travel!


#### Amanda Wiltshire-Craine


Senior Vice President and Head of Financial Solutions Operations, Fiserv


Amanda Wiltshire-Craine is Senior Vice President and Head of Financial Solutions Operations at Fiserv, where she leads operations supporting core banking platforms and related solutions for banks, credit unions, and issuers. A global operations and customer experience executive, she brings deep expertise in large-scale transformation, AI and automation, operational excellence, and customer-centric innovation across financial services and technology.


Throughout her career, Amanda has built, transformed, and led global organizations of more than 23,000 employees and managed multi-billion-dollar budgets. She has held senior executive roles at PayPal, Wells Fargo, Citi, and American Express, bringing together technology, operations, and human-centered service to strengthen customer outcomes, manage risk, and drive sustainable business performance.
Amanda also serves on the Board of Directors of Hot Bread Kitchen and as an Advisor to Anna (formerly TPG, Inc.) – a privately held AI and data company focused on CX. She holds an MBA from NYU Stern School of Business and a BSFS from Georgetown University. Amanda is based in New York City.


As a panelist, Amanda offers a practical executive perspective on leading through disruption, scaling innovation responsibly, and translating emerging technology into measurable value for customers, employees, and the business.


#### Katie Linendoll


Host & Moderator


#### Kathryn Harrison


Global VP, Strategy & Business Operations, Concentrix


Kathryn Harrison is a global business leader and serial entrepreneur who leads the Global Product Organization at Concentrix, where she draws on experience scaling teams and helping organizations adapt to change across international markets. Before joining Concentrix, she held leadership roles at IBM and GLG, helped lead IBM Blockchain, and built and sold a software company in the collectibles space. Her career spans high-impact deals across Asia, Europe, Australia, and the U.S., advising governments and Fortune 100 firms along the way. She is passionate about using technology to build a more human world.


#### Tom McCormick


Tom McCormick is a global operations and customer experience executive with more than 30 years of leadership experience across financial services, technology, and business process outsourcing.


During his 16-year career at Capital One, Tom helped shape global CX and operations strategy, overseeing complex outsourcing ecosystems, strategic partnerships, geographic expansion, and enterprise governance. His international experience spans the Americas, Africa, and Asia, including establishing and scaling a Global Capability Center in the Philippines.


Today, as an independent advisor, Tom advises organizations on global sourcing strategy, enterprise readiness, strategic growth, and AI-enabled operational transformation. He is passionate about connecting operational excellence with meaningful social impact, particularly through sustainable job creation in emerging markets.


Tom brings a distinctive enterprise buyer perspective, global operational experience, and a commitment to building high-performing organizations where people, technology, and purpose come together to deliver lasting value.


#### Quinten Hout


Global Vice President in Risk and Compliance Practice, Concentrix


Quinten has led consulting teams supporting some of the largest global financial institutions, has started and sold a FCC SaaS company, and has led global financial crime managed service firms.


Quinten Hout is the Global Vice President in charge of Concentrix’s Risk and Compliance Practice. Quinten’s has over 15 years of experience in risk and compliance experience As a technologist by background, he has successfully built a FCC SaaS company which he sold in 2019. He started and managed the global financial crimes business for a prestigious strategy consulting company supporting some of the world’s largest banks with complex regulatory, risk, and technology projects. He has led the global financial crimes practice for several top managed service companies where he has oversight of thousands of global agents.


At Concentrix, Quinten leads the global FCC practice of over 15,000 professionals supporting over 75 clients operating out of 100+ countries spanning 25 delivery countries. He is responsible for defining the practice’s strategy, partnering with clients to design people, process, and technology solutions, and ensuring operational excellence across all R&C engagements.


#### Jeffrey Bashore


Financial Crimes Executive


Jeff Bashore is a financial crimes executive with more than 24 years leading fraud, anti-money laundering, and claims operations at some of the largest U.S. financial institutions. He is now building a managed services venture that pairs expert practitioners with agentic automation to help banks modernize their fraud programs.


Most recently, Jeff was Senior Vice President and Head of Member Protection at USAA. He led fraud, first-line AML, and bank claims for an organization of 3,200 employees and contractors, protecting $1.2 trillion in annual member payments. His team resolved longstanding regulatory issues and reduced fraud losses by 64%. Before USAA, he led Fraud Prevention and Detection at Bank of America, where he modernized the fraud program serving 67 million clients and cut the total cost of fraud by 54%. Earlier, he spent 16 years at Citi in fraud, claims, and operations leadership roles across North America and globally.


Jeff is a named inventor on four patents in fraud management technology. A graduate of Shippensburg University, he serves on the Shippensburg University Foundation Board of Directors and the John L. Grove College of Business Advisory Board, and on the advisory boards of the St. Augustine YMCA and the Protential Foundation. Jeff and his family reside in St. Augustine, Florida.


#### Ed Hartigan


Director, Trust and Safety, Concentrix


Ed is a Director in our Trust & Safety and AI Data Services practice, bringing over 20 years of experience at the intersection of digital platforms, AI, and global operations. He specializes in designing and scaling high-risk, high-sensitivity programs that require expert human judgment, robust governance, and seamless integration of AI-augmented workflows.


Ed plays a key role in supporting enterprise clients across North America, leading growth initiatives while acting as a senior SME for complex Trust & Safety and AI data operations.


Prior to Concentrix, Ed was Director of Webhelp’s Digital Content Services (DCS) practice, where he led Marketing Services and contributed to the evolution of Trust & Safety and digital operations capabilities ahead of the merger.
Earlier in his career, Ed spent 8 years at Dentsu (iProspect), where he held senior leadership roles including Head of Social Media and Head of Earned Media & Content in London. There, he led large, multi-market teams across social, influencer, and content operations, experience that now directly informs his approach to platform integrity, online safety, and user-generated content ecosystems.


#### Sherry Graziano


Head of Client Experience and Digital, Truist Financial Corporation


Sherry Graziano is Head of Client Experience and Digital for Truist Financial Corporation and a member of Truist’s Executive Management Committee. She leads enterprise client experience strategy across the full client lifecycle and the digital platforms, products and experiences that help more than 14 million clients manage their financial lives. Her organization combines insights, client journeys, operational excellence and cross-functional partnerships to deliver seamless, consistent experiences, accelerate digital growth and strengthen client loyalty. Her team manages digital channels that account for 71% of Truist’s total transactions and bring in more than 40% of its new-to-bank clients. They advance capabilities including personalization, AI-enabled experiences and open banking to make banking easier and more intuitive. Graziano also serves as an executive board member of future Truist India, helping expand global capabilities to champion innovation and improve client and teammate experience


#### Amanda Bohr


National Director of Client Experience, Bernstein Private Wealth Management


Amanda Bohr is the National Director of Client Experience for Bernstein Private Wealth Management, where she leads strategic initiatives that strengthen client engagement and elevate the client experience across the firm. With more than 15 years of cross-industry experience spanning wealth management, technology, wellness, beauty, and the performing arts, she is passionate about translating client needs into meaningful solutions that create lasting impact.


Since joining Bernstein in 2016, Amanda has held a variety of roles across the business, including Engagement Product Owner, Vice President of Technology Partnerships, and Director of UHNW Strategic Partnerships before assuming her current role.
Amanda holds a Master of Science in Integrated Marketing Communications and a Bachelor of Arts from Northwestern University.


#### Misty Stiers


Head of Inclusive Design, Citi Design and User Experience


Visionary executive leader with 25+ years transforming organizations through culture-first design, radical inclusion, and cross-functional collaboration. Known for dismantling organizational silos, building psychologically safe teams, and operationalizing creative strategy into measurable business outcomes. A patent-holding innovator and award-winning author who brings equal fluency in boardroom strategy and hands-on creative execution — and the rare ability to inspire both. She currently lives in Hells Kitchen, NYC, and finds her greatest enchantment and most fulfilling role as wife to Sam and mama to Samaire and Wylie.


#### Mike Leary


Senior Vice President and Research & Insights Lead, Huntington National Bank


Mike Leary is Senior Vice President and Research & Insights Lead at Huntington National Bank. With more than 30 years of experience in research, analytics, and customer experience, Mike has built his career turning complex customer and market insights into actionable business strategy. His experience spans financial services, insurance, retail, healthcare, and consulting, including leadership roles at Nationwide Insurance, Office Depot, and Capital One. At Huntington, he leads enterprise primary research and works across the organization to ensure customer and colleague insights inform strategic decisions and experience improvements.


#### Brett Chereskin


COO, DUB


Brett Chereskin is the Chief Operating Officer of dub, a copy trading platform that brings transparency and access to retail investors. He also sits on dub’s Board of Directors. Brett oversees the company’s operations, including customer experience, brokerage operations, finance, and HR, and is leading dub’s move to AI-native operations. Before dub, he was Head of Business Operations at Affirm, where he led corporate planning, business operations, and product operations. Brett started his career with 12 years in the U.S. Army as a commissioned officer and aviator. He is a graduate of the United States Military Academy at West Point and holds a master’s degree in unmanned systems from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University.


#### Shy Daraeikia


Risk and Compliance Practice Lead, North America, Concentrix


Shy Daraeikia leads the North America Risk and Compliance Practice at Concentrix, advising global brands across financial services, energy, retail, and social media on turning complex risk challenges into practical operating strategies. Before joining Concentrix, he helped bring to market technology supporting federal intelligence “follow-the-money” initiatives and financial crime compliance platforms for Tier 1 banking institutions. He holds the Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) designation and brings a background spanning technology, risk analytics, and managed services, connecting how organizations understand risk with how they manage it.


#### Guy Bourgault


Head of Agentic Services, Concentrix


Guy has been working in the technology industry to help organizations design, build and run experiences for over 20 years. Recently he has been leading Agentic AI Services and Solutions globally for Concentrix. Based in Portland Oregon, Guy is originally from the New England area and attended Bases College in Lewiston, ME. When not envisioning the future of work with Humans + AI, Guy enjoys coaching alpine ski racing on the slopes of Mount Hood.


#### Adam Lemmon


VP, Partnerships — Identity, Agentic Commerce & Bitcoin, Proof


With over a decade of experience in digital identity and credentials, Adam helps lead Proof’s strategic initiatives and ecosystem partnerships with a focus on financial services, agentic and x401 adoption. Prior to Proof, Adam was one of the original authors of OpenID for Verifiable Credentials (now globally adopted as OID4VCI and OID4VP) and led partnerships at MATTR.


#### Tim Carbery


Vice President, Risk and Compliance Practice, Concentrix


Tim Carbery is Vice President, Risk and Compliance Practice at Concentrix, where he co-leads its GRC work. He has spent his career in operations and risk management and takes a process-first approach to risk strategy, regulatory change, third-party risk, resilience and AI governance, integrating them across the enterprise rather than function by function. He co-founded CastleHill Managed Risk Solutions, which Concentrix acquired in 2026.


## Let’s meet at the top


From sessions featuring some of the world’s best brands to insights from the top voices in tech, this Circle event is one you can’t afford to miss.
